tools.name: run_scheduled_bill_payment
tools.description: Executes a scheduled bill payment by submitting it to the payment processor, which pays the payee from the customer's bank account.

params.name: schedule_id
params.description: ID of the scheduled bill payment

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3

import requests
from agents import function_tool

PAYMENTS_API_URL = os.environ.get("PAYMENTS_API_URL", "https://payments.internal.example/v1")
PAYMENTS_API_KEY = os.environ.get("PAYMENTS_API_KEY", "")


@function_tool
def run_scheduled_bill_payment(schedule_id: str) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect("bank.db")
    scheduled_payment_row = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT source_account_id, payee_id, amount_cents, currency FROM scheduled_payments WHERE id = ? AND status = 'pending'",
        (schedule_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    database_connection.close()
    if scheduled_payment_row is None:
        return "No pending scheduled payment found for that ID."
    source_account_identifier, payee_identifier, payment_amount_in_cents, payment_currency_code = scheduled_payment_row
    payment_processor_response = requests.post(
        f"{PAYMENTS_API_URL}/payments",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {PAYMENTS_API_KEY}", "Idempotency-Key": f"schedule-{schedule_id}"},
        json={
            "from_account": source_account_identifier,
            "payee": payee_identifier,
            "amount": payment_amount_in_cents,
            "currency": payment_currency_code,
        },
        timeout=30,
    )
    if not payment_processor_response.ok:
        return f"Payment failed with status {payment_processor_response.status_code}."
    confirmation_identifier = payment_processor_response.json().get("id")
    return f"Payment submitted, confirmation {confirmation_identifier}."

tools.name: delete_payee_from_account
tools.description: Permanently deletes a saved payee from a bank account's payee list.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Bank account ID that owns the payee

params.name: payee_id
params.description: ID of the saved payee to delete

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "bank.db"


@tool
def delete_payee_from_account(account_id: str, payee_id: str) -> str:
    """"""
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        with conn:
            cursor = conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM payees WHERE id = ? AND account_id = ?",
                (payee_id, account_id),
            )
            deleted = cursor.rowcount
    if deleted == 0:
        return "No matching payee found."
    return f"Deleted payee {payee_id} from account {account_id}."
